name: Complete onboarding and keep the learner identity
description: Verifies the approved onboarding still creates a durable learner profile and reaches Home.
steps: Enter QA Learner as the learner name and continue
expected: Home still greets QA Learner with the saved profile and onboarding does not reappear.

name: Launch Tetris from the new text-content Launchpad
setup: Complete onboarding as QA Learner using Robot
description: Verifies the redesigned mission flow can create a grounded text session and launch a selected visual game.
steps: Choose Nueva sesión and select Texto
Enter the title Célula QA and paste a multi-sentence study text with at least eight informative sentences about cells, membranes, mitochondria, DNA, ribosomes, Golgi, lysosomes and homeostasis
expected: The training arena opens for Tetris, shows Célula QA as the content title, and preserves the learner profile.

name: Reject an invalid YouTube source
setup: Complete onboarding as QA Learner using Robot
description: Verifies the Launchpad does not pretend a non-YouTube URL is a linked learning video.
steps: Choose Nueva sesión and keep YouTube selected
Enter https://example.com/not-youtube in the YouTube field
expected: A visible validation message says a valid YouTube video must be linked before the session can start, and the training arena does not open.

name: Change the companion avatar without losing progress
setup: Complete onboarding as QA Learner using Robot
description: Verifies an existing learner can change companion from Profile without recreating the account.
steps: Refresh the page and open Perfil again
expected: QA Learner still exists and Zorro is shown as the selected companion after refresh.

name: Create a baseline session without the secondary game
setup: Complete onboarding as QA Learner using Robot
description: Verifies baseline remains available from the simplified Launchpad without exposing the old technical form.
steps: Choose Nueva sesión and select Texto
Enter the title Baseline QA and paste a multi-sentence study text with at least eight informative sentences
Choose Baseline and then Crear baseline
expected: The training arena opens in BASELINE condition and states that the secondary visuomotor task is off.
